definitions.gloss: ticket booth; ticket counter; ticket window
definitions.explanation: A location where tickets are sold, especially at train stations.

examples.japanese: {切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}はどこですか。
{切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}で{定期券|ていきけん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a commuter pass at the ticket counter.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}には{長|なが}い{列|れつ}ができていた。
examples.english: There was a long line at the station's ticket booth.

notes:
STRUCTURE:
{切符|きっぷ} (ticket) + {売|う}り{場|ば} (selling place)

MODERN CONTEXT:
Many stations now have {券売機|けんばいき} (ticket vending machines), but {切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば} still exists for:
・{定期券|ていきけん} (commuter passes)
・{特急券|とっきゅうけん} (express tickets)
・Complex routes
・Assistance with tickets

SYNONYMS:
・{窓口|まどぐち} - ticket window, service counter
・チケット{売|う}り{場|ば} - ticket counter (events)

RELATED TERMS:
・{券売機|けんばいき} - ticket vending machine
・{改札口|かいさつぐち} - ticket gate
